meta.subject: English
meta.topic: Activity 2 of 9 (quiz/game): Guided Fill-In - Using Voice and Mood for Effect
meta.title: Voice and Mood Memory Match

questions.prompt: The committee recommends that the proposal ____ reviewed.
questions.explanation: Be is the base form required in the mandative subjunctive after verbs like recommend.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: The novel ____ the reader's imagination.
questions.explanation: Captures uses active voice to give the novel agency over the action.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Using the simple past for the hypothetical condition, if the coach ____ more clearly, the players would understand the strategy.
questions.explanation: The simple past spoke expresses the hypothetical condition in a second-conditional sentence.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Which form completes the sentence in the subjunctive mood: The judge requires that each witness ____ the question clearly under oath.
questions.explanation: The subjunctive form after requires takes the base form answer.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the active voice: The rare map was donated by a retired collector.
choices: A retired collector was donated the rare map.
A retired collector donated the rare map.
A retired collector had donate the rare map.
A retired collector donated rare map.
questions.explanation: The active voice makes the retired collector the doer and uses donated with the rare map as the object.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Since sunrise, the volunteers ____ every tent.
questions.explanation: Since sunrise calls for the present perfect, and have packed keeps the volunteers active as the people doing the packing.
questions.skill: Using active voice with the present perfect
questions.topic: Guided Fill-In — Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: I wish that he ____ here now.
questions.explanation: Were expresses a wish contrary to reality in the subjunctive mood.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Using the simple present for the condition, if the fog ____, we will drive more slowly.
questions.explanation: The simple present lifts expresses the likely future condition in a first-conditional sentence.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Using the subjunctive mood, complete the sentence: The director requests that each employee ____ the form before the meeting.
questions.explanation: After requests, the subjunctive uses the base form submit even though each employee is singular.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: If she ____ more time, she would finish the project.
questions.explanation: A counterfactual conditional uses the past perfect 'had' in the if‑clause to show an unreal past condition.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the passive voice: The storm knocked down the old sign.
choices: The old sign had been knocked down by the storm.
The old sign was knocking down by the storm.
The old sign was knocked down by the storm.
The old sign was knocked down the storm.
questions.explanation: The passive voice places the old sign in the subject position and uses was knocked down with a by-phrase identifying the storm.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: For a direct emergency command, complete the sentence: ____ the building immediately.
questions.explanation: A direct command uses the base form of the verb without a subject, so the correct form is Leave.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Rewrite the sentence in the passive voice: The judges selected the finalists.
choices: The finalists are selected by the judges.
The finalists were selected by the judges.
The finalists were selected the judges.
The finalists have selected the judges.
questions.explanation: The passive construction The finalists were selected by the judges makes the finalists the focus and preserves the original past tense.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: If the instructions ____ clearly, new volunteers would not have made errors.
questions.explanation: Had been written is the passive past-perfect form needed for the third-conditional condition.
questions.skill: Using passive voice in a third conditional
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Complete the third conditional: If the warning lights ____ earlier, the drivers could have slowed down.
questions.explanation: In the third conditional, had flashed is required for the earlier unreal condition, while could have slowed expresses the counterfactual result.
questions.topic: Guided Fill-In — Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence in the subjunctive mood: It is essential that every passenger ____ seated before departure.
questions.explanation: An essential that clause takes the base form remain in the subjunctive mood to describe a continuing state.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: To emphasize the results rather than the researcher, the writer chose the ____ voice.
questions.explanation: Passive voice shifts focus to the results instead of the person performing the action.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Rewrite the sentence in the passive voice: The science club organized the poster exhibition.
choices: The poster exhibition was organized by the science club.
The science club was organized the poster exhibition.
The poster exhibition organized the science club.
The science club organized was the poster exhibition.
questions.explanation: The passive voice makes the poster exhibition the subject and uses was organized with the science club as the agent.
questions.skill: Converting active voice to passive voice
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Should the weather ____ , the event will move indoors.
questions.explanation: Change follows the inverted “should” conditional structure for a hypothetical future.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Please ____ the door when you leave.
questions.explanation: The imperative mood uses the base form of the verb to give a direct command or request.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: ____ your name at the top of the page.
questions.explanation: The imperative mood gives a direct command using the base form of the verb.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Convert to active: The results were announced by the manager.
choices: The manager was announced by the results.
questions.explanation: The active version makes the doer "the manager" the subject and uses the past‑tense verb "announced".
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence in the subjunctive mood: I would prefer that you ____ the earlier train.
questions.explanation: The base form take is used after would prefer that to express the speaker's preference in the subjunctive.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: To stress the doer of the action, the writer chose the ____ voice.
questions.explanation: The active voice makes the subject the performer of the action, highlighting agency.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: The teacher insisted that each student ____ the assignment by Friday.
questions.explanation: In a mandative subjunctive clause, the base form of the verb follows expressions like 'insisted that'.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Complete the direct command: At the sound of the bell, ____ your papers face down on the desk.
questions.explanation: The imperative mood uses the base form place when addressing the person directly.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: If I ____ you, I would study harder.
questions.explanation: Were is the subjunctive form used for contrary‑to‑fact conditionals.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Using the subjunctive mood, complete the sentence: The doctor insists that each athlete ____ for a concussion evaluation before practice.
questions.explanation: Be evaluated is the passive subjunctive form used after insists that when each athlete is the subject of the action.
questions.skill: Using subjunctive mood with passive voice
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: It is crucial that the committee ____ the proposal before Friday.
questions.explanation: Expressions of necessity such as 'it is crucial that' require the subjunctive mood, which uses the base form of the verb.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Before crossing the tracks, ____ the warning light.
questions.explanation: A direct command uses the imperative mood, so the correct instruction is check.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Unless the data ___ verified, the conclusion remains tentative.
questions.explanation: With a plural subject "data" in a real present conditional, the verb takes the plural present form "are".
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: If the experiment ____ successful, we will publish the results.
questions.explanation: The indicative present "is" matches the real‑condition "if" clause referring to a likely future event.
questions.skill: Selecting appropriate verb voice and mood
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: The coach suggests that the player ____ early for practice.
questions.explanation: After a verb of suggestion, the base form "arrive" is required in the subjunctive mood.
questions.skill: Selecting appropriate verb voice and mood
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: In the simple past active voice, the hikers ____ the trail before sunrise.
questions.explanation: In the simple past active voice, the subject hikers performs the action, so the verb is reached.
questions.skill: Choosing active voice and simple past
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: In the passive voice and simple past, the scores ____ by the judges.
questions.explanation: The simple past passive is formed with was or were plus the past participle, yielding were entered.
questions.skill: Choosing passive voice and simple past
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Had the researchers ___ the anomaly earlier, they would have adjusted the model.
questions.explanation: The past‑perfect conditional clause requires the past participle "noticed" after "had".
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Change the following to passive voice: The director approved the budget.
choices: The budget is approved by the director.
The budget was approved by the director.
The budget approved by the director.
The director was approved by the budget.
questions.explanation: The passive voice version makes the budget the subject and uses 'was approved by the director'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence in the subjunctive mood: The librarian requests that each visitor ____ the borrowed book.
questions.explanation: A requests that clause uses the base form return in the subjunctive mood, regardless of the subject's number.
questions.skill: Using the subjunctive after a request
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: For a first conditional, the if-clause uses the present tense: if the bus ____ late, the team will miss the opening ceremony.
questions.explanation: A first conditional places the condition in the present tense, so the correct form is arrives.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: To give a direct command, the writer used the ____ mood.
questions.explanation: The imperative mood is used for direct commands.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence in the subjunctive mood: The judge ordered that the witness ____ the truth.
questions.explanation: The base form tell is used in the subjunctive construction ordered that the witness tell the truth.
questions.skill: Using base form in the subjunctive mood
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: If each guide ____ the key exhibit by noon, the museum will open early tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The condition of a first conditional sentence uses the simple present, so the singular subject each guide takes prepares.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Use the past hypothetical condition: If I ____ the neighborhood well, I would suggest that restaurant.
questions.explanation: The second conditional pairs the past form knew with would to describe an unreal condition in the present.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Use the active voice to emphasize the volunteers: After the flood, volunteers ____ damaged homes.
questions.explanation: The simple-past active form repaired makes the volunteers the doer of the action.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: If the engineer ____ the flaw, the bridge would not collapse.
questions.explanation: In a second conditional, the if-clause uses the past simple form of the verb to express a hypothetical present situation.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Make the actor the subject while preserving the original tense: The final sculpture was unveiled by the mayor.
choices: The mayor unveil the final sculpture.
The mayor unveiled the final sculpture.
The mayor unveils the final sculpture.
The mayor unveiled the final sculptures.
questions.explanation: Putting the mayor in the subject position creates active voice while unveiled preserves the original past tense.
questions.skill: Transforming passive voice into active voice
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Using active voice for the past hypothetical condition, if the committee ____ the schedule sooner, the volunteers could have prepared.
questions.explanation: An active past hypothetical condition uses had plus the past participle, giving had approved.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Using the subjunctive mood, complete the sentence: The trainer recommends that each athlete ____ the safety rules before practice.
questions.explanation: In the subjunctive mood, recommend takes that plus the base form review, and the active voice keeps the athlete as the doer.
questions.topic: Guided Fill-In — Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: Put the object first while preserving the original tense: The storm damaged the old greenhouse.
choices: The old greenhouse was damaged by the storm.
The old greenhouse was damage by the storm.
The old greenhouse are damaged by the storm.
The old greenhouse damaged by the storm.
questions.explanation: The passive construction makes the old greenhouse the subject and uses was damaged to preserve the past tense.
questions.skill: Transforming active voice into passive voice
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect

questions.prompt: The curator advises that every guest ____ the exhibit before noon.
questions.explanation: In a that-clause following advises, the subjunctive mood takes the base form view.
questions.topic: Using Voice and Mood for Effect
